compact.header:
[post-compaction check | {time}]

You have just been through a context compaction. Everything below points at
where the truth is. None of it IS the truth — check the live state before you
act on any of it.

blocks.long_running_task:
You were in the middle of a long-running task.
- Fetch the current state from the source of truth before doing anything.
- **You may have already taken this turn's action before the compaction.**
  Look first; do not take it twice.
- A compaction is not a restart. Whatever you were assigned is still assigned.
blocks.scheduled:
You woke yourself on a schedule. **Nobody is talking to you.**
- The commands for scheduled runs are in `{home}/wake_commands.md`. Read that
  file when you need them — they are deliberately not in CLAUDE.md, so that a
  compaction summary cannot leave you with a half-remembered command.
- Leave a record of what you did before you finish. Nobody is watching this
  terminal; the record is the only way the run is visible.
blocks.inbound_chat:
Something outside sent you a message.
- Check for unread items before replying, rather than replying to the one
  message that happened to survive the compaction.
- Use the tools for this, not hand-rolled HTTP. After a compaction the shape of
  your tools is one of the first things to go fuzzy.
blocks.direct:
A person is typing to you directly.
- You cannot tell from the text alone which person it is. **Ask, don't guess.**
blocks.unknown:
Cannot tell what you were doing.
- Do not guess. Read the recent turns and confirm before you say anything.

compact.footer:
If the context starts feeling heavy again, write a short handover note before
you continue — where you got to, what is happening around you, what has been
agreed, and which threads are still open.
